Allegations of Gold Missing from Kashi Vishwanath Temple Gilded Dome

Allegations have surfaced that gold is missing from the gilded dome of the Kashi Vishwanath temple. A complaint regarding this matter has reportedly reached the Prime Minister's Office (PMO). Temple administration has responded to the claims.
